scope: The File-mode Shader Editor discovers uniforms from the compiled program layout used by the renderer. The native workflow used a project-relative GLSL file.
catalog: The app test verified stable revisions for one compiled layout, rejection of mismatched paths and formats, and retirement of stale owners.

windows.defaultsAndEdit: External-file defaults and Add All worked. The Inspector edit changed the output from green to yellow.
windows.reload: An atomic file replacement refreshed the same open controls, hid the removed declaration, and exposed the new one. The retained control kept its identity and its edit. An Add All request with the previous revision was rejected.
windows.persistence: Editing the new control rendered red. Reopening the project restored the red output and the original control UUID and value.

remaining: Shader Library browsing and drag-and-drop from local, ShaderToy, ISF and FragCoord.XYZ sources remain in M18/4.
